statement: For Linux game play, implement an Elite Series 2-specific linux.uinput realization that publishes stock xpad-compatible evdev axes, ordinary keys and four BTN_GRIP* capabilities, with caller-selected identity at creation. Gate/suppress the four paddle events when the selected emulation model has active remapping, and expose unimplemented GIP, battery, independent trigger-motor and profile semantics as limitations. This does not create a real USB Elite/GIP device or imply physical fidelity.

applicability.revision: Xbox Elite Series 2 model 1797, software-side revision at pinned sources
applicability.scope: Implementation proposal based on xpad and SDL mapping only; no host, hardware or consumer tests. Distinct from already merged standard Xbox Series realization.
